scores.tell: Scene has many depth layers (far trees, path, mid bushes, table and stools) with a fairly deep landscape; table top is seen from above at a clear angle, but the stools' tops and the table's chessboard use slightly different perspective strengths. It resembles the real swing card's layered garden, but the horizon is a bit high and the scene is wider than most single-object cards.

Hero is a front-on, nearly orthographic coffin with only a sliver of side face. It stands on a flat grass field with a shadow cast to the right, and the ground plane angle doesn't match the hero's flat front view. The background is only soft hills and bushes, so the layers are too few and the hero looks pasted on. Real cards show more top face and a tilted hero.

none: the calculator is tilted with a mild, consistent perspective and a strong top face. The flat pattern background has no ground plane, like the real towel card. Its keys, body and screen all share one view.
